text:
mohit: Heads up — after the RBAC cleanup in inference-ns this morning several CI deploys started failing with Forbidden and KMS errors. Not sure if it's the rolebinding prune or the serviceaccount token scope change.

alice: Can you paste the failing error?

mohit: Here — from the CI job logs:

```\nError from server (Forbidden): error when creating \"-\": pods \"inference-worker-xyz\" is forbidden: User \"system:serviceaccount:inference:deploy-sa\" cannot create resource \"pods\" in API group \"\" in the namespace \"inference\"\n2026-03-20T09:12:11Z kms:AccessDenied: Access denied for decrypt on key projects/xxx/locations/global/keyRings/rlw/cryptoKeys/model-enc\n```

kevin: That looks like both k8s RBAC and KMS policy gaps. Did the rolebinding that used to give `deploy-sa` clusterwide rights get replaced with a namespaced Role?

mohit: Yes — PR #1482 replaced a ClusterRoleBinding with a RoleBinding scoped to inference-ns to satisfy least-privilege. CI still expects the SA to create pods in a couple other namespaces (test/puppeteer).

sara: We should avoid reintroducing broad privileges. Short-term mitigation: give the CI serviceaccount a minimal ClusterRole that only allows creation of pods and deploys but nothing else. Long term: update CI to use distinct serviceaccounts per namespace.

emily: Also need to check why KMS decrypt fails. That looks like the KMS IAM binding for the service account was removed or the key policy is restrictive. Can someone run `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` (or equivalent) and `kubectl describe secret` for the SA token fetcher?

mohit: Running commands now. Output snippets:

```\n$ kubectl auth can-i create pods --as=system:serviceaccount:inference:deploy-sa -n puppeteer\nno\n\n$ gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/xxx/locations/global/keyRings/rlw/cryptoKeys/model-enc\nbindings:\n- members:\n  - serviceAccount:old-deploy@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com\n  role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter\n```

kevin: Aha — KMS still references the old GSA. During the RBAC cleanup we deleted the GSA binding that mapped deploy-sa -> old-deploy GSA. That mapping was used for key decryption.

sara: Action plan (hot):
- grant a temporary narrow ClusterRole `ci-deploy-lite` with verbs: create/get/list on pods, deployments, replicasets in the few namespaces CI touches.
- rebind deploy-sa to the GSA used by KMS (or add current GSA to the KMS key policy).
- rotate tokens if any SA tokens were exposed during the change.

mohit: I'll open the incident ticket and apply the temp ClusterRole after approvals. Need someone from security to sign off on the KMS policy change. @alice?

alice: I'll sign off for emergency change; prefer we add only the GSA with decrypt role rather than re-granting broad KMS access.

deploy-bot: Approval requested for clusterrolebinding creation: `ci-deploy-lite` -> deploy-sa (inference). Please react with :thumbsup: to approve.

kevin: I'll prepare the exact YAML. Proposed ClusterRole (minimal):

```\napiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1\nkind: ClusterRole\nmetadata:\n  name: ci-deploy-lite\nrules:\n- apiGroups: [\"\"]\n  resources: [\"pods\"]\n  verbs: [\"create\",\"get\",\"list\"]\n- apiGroups: [\"apps\"]\n  resources: [\"deployments\",\"replicasets\"]\n  verbs: [\"get\",\"list\",\"update\",\"patch\"]\n```

emily: For KMS: I'll open a KMS IAM change request to add `serviceAccount:inference-deploy@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com` with roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter. We should log the justification and set TTL for the binding (30d) so we can re-evaluate.

sara: Good. Also update the audit policy to include explicit resource attributes for SA->GSA mappings so this doesn't slip through. Audit-bot, can you ensure the mapping change gets an audit note?

audit-bot: Noted. Writing entry: "RBAC cleanup PR#1482 changed SA->GSA mappings; triggered denied deploys and KMS access loss" to compliance-audit.

mohit: Quick smoke after temp fixes: CI deploy succeeded for the two failing jobs. Will keep monitoring.

alice: Post-incident follow-ups:
- kevin to create a PR that scopes CI roles per-namespace and documents SA requirements.
- emily to add the KMS IAM change with TTL and monitoring alert for KMS AccessDenied spikes.
- sara to add a checklist to the RBAC refactor playbook to run `kubectl auth can-i` matrix for all affected SAs and CI jobs.

kevin: I'll draft the PR and include tests that run can-i as part of the RBAC gate.

mohit: Thanks all. Filing the incident ticket now and marking severity P2. If we see more KMS AccessDenied after policy changes we escalate to infra oncall. :white_check_mark:

sara: Nice containment. Let's make the temporary ClusterRole expire via TTL automation in 48h unless PR is merged.

emily: Will add the alert and TTL automation entry.

mohit: Closing thread for now, will update incident ticket with remediation links and PR numbers.
